auth_methods.quote: System user access tokens (“system tokens”) represent you, your business, organization, or people within your business or organization.
auth_methods.note: Direct developers call Cloud API with long-lived System User tokens (Authorization: Bearer). Tech Providers get Business Integration System User tokens via Embedded Signup (OAuth-style code exchange); short-lived user tokens come from Facebook Login.

credential_access.quote: Make sure to retain both your test phone number ID and Messaging account ID for later use.
credential_access.note: Free Meta developer account + app gives a test phone number and token for development; production messaging is usage-priced but credentials are self-serve.

production_gate.quote: App Review grants you Advanced access to the following permissions, which are required to become a Tech Provider
production_gate.note: For a multi-tenant integrator serving other businesses: Tech Provider onboarding needs business verification plus App Review for Advanced access to whatsapp_business_messaging/management.

api_type.quote: The WhatsApp Business Platform is built on Graph API and uses HTTP protocol.
api_type.note: Graph API HTTP/JSON endpoints (REST-style). Not GraphQL.

mcp_official.quote: Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta Ads capabilities to your agentic workflows.
mcp_official.note: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP at mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business; focuses on account/number/template setup and test messaging.

main_blocker_type.quote: To become a tech provider you need to verify your business with Meta
main_blocker_type.note: Business verification + App Review is the main gate to serving customers' accounts. Direct own-account use would be 'none'; chosen reading is the multi-tenant one.
